thread:
incident-bot: PAGED: eng-platform @devon — sustained spike in external action_call errors and elevated tail latency on /v1/action_exec (multi-region). 5xx rate ~12% over 5m, error budget at risk.

devon: on it, grabbing traces and tenant breakdown. starting runbook check.

samir: I see a surge from two tenants and a bunch of small bursty calls from free tier. KV cache miss rate jumped.

devon: yep — AcmeChat and FlowHire are top noisy tenants. free-tier traffic is ~40% of requests right now.

maria: putting mitigation proposal: 1) soft-throttle free tier action_call concurrency, 2) disable structured/action_result output streaming for best-effort routes, 3) shift heavy traffic to degraded text-only fallback model variant. thoughts?

samir: agree. prefer graceful: throttle new external action_call start, allow in-progress to finish. toggle structured output off to cut downstream cost.

devon: executing first step: /runbook apply throttle --scope tier:free --limit 2rps --reason "emergency noise suppression"

ops-bot: JOB OK — throttle policy applied (policy_id: ephem-throttle-3077). Affected services: inference-gateway, action-router.

maria: executing structured-output toggle: POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/flags/structured_output_disable { "scope": "best_effort_routes", "duration": "30m" }

ops-bot: FLAG SET — structured_output_disable=true for best_effort_routes (expires in 30m).

samir: rolling model fallback rule: route tenant AcmeChat and FlowHire to small-llama-quantized variant with faster kernel. issuing route update now.

devon: route update acknowledged. traffic shift starting, will ramp over 60s window.

amy-cs: pinging AcmeChat & FlowHire CSMs with heads-up: "We observed elevated action execution errors and are temporarily restricting agent-style outputs to stabilize service. We'll share ETA and mitigation updates."

maria: also enabling quota uplift protection so the throttle doesn't cascade into auth failures for paid plans. /runbook apply quota-exempt --plans:paid --reason "prevent paid customer failover"

ops-bot: QUOTA UPDATE SUCCESS — paid plans exempted from ephem-throttle-3077.

samir: monitoring: overall 5xx back down to 4.2% in 4m since toggles. p99 latency down ~35%. free-tier requests dropped ~38%.

devon: good signal. leaving structured_output disabled and throttle in place for now. setting next checkpoint in 20m.

hannah: taking handoff at +22m. I'll keep the throttle and structured flag until we confirm stable metrics for 30m then coordinate phased rollback.

amy-cs: will send post-mortem note to affected customers and open support tickets for AcmeChat/FlowHire to get logs/story to them.

devon: thanks team. summarize actions for incident log: applied ephemeral free-tier throttle, disabled best-effort structured/action outputs, routed two noisy tenants to quantized fallback, exempted paid plans. monitoring ongoing.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied by @devon/@maria/@samir. status: stabilizing. next update in 20m. paging handed to @hannah.
